/**
 * The language servers live on this machine: started on the first question, at most `cap` at
 * once (starting one more stops the one asked least lately), and each stopped after `idleMs`
 * without a question. A server is 1-3 GB on a real repo; 4 of them is the most the design allows.
 */

export interface Stoppable { stop(): void | Promise<void> }

interface Live<S> { server: Promise<S>; usedAt: number; idle: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> }

export interface PoolOptions {
  cap?: number;
  idleMs?: number;
  /** A server was stopped, by its key, and why. */
  onStop?(key: string, why: "idle" | "cap" | "closed"): void;
}

export class ServerPool<S extends Stoppable> {
  private readonly live = new Map<string, Live<S>>();
  private readonly cap: number;
  private readonly idleMs: number;
  private tick = 0;

  constructor(private readonly opts: PoolOptions = {}) {
    this.cap = opts.cap ?? 4;
    this.idleMs = opts.idleMs ?? 10 * 60_000;
  }

  /** The server for `key`, started by `start` when none is live. A start that fails is not kept. */
  use(key: string, start: () => Promise<S>): Promise<S> {
    const had = this.live.get(key);
    if (had) {
      clearTimeout(had.idle);
      had.idle = this.idleTimer(key);
      had.usedAt = ++this.tick;
      return had.server;
    }
    while (this.live.size >= this.cap) this.stop(this.leastLately()!, "cap");
    const server = start();
    this.live.set(key, { server, usedAt: ++this.tick, idle: this.idleTimer(key) });
    server.catch(() => {
      const now = this.live.get(key);
      if (now?.server === server) { clearTimeout(now.idle); this.live.delete(key); }
    });
    return server;
  }

  /** The keys of the servers live now. */
  keys(): string[] { return [...this.live.keys()]; }

  /** The servers live now (some may still be starting), by key. */
  servers(): [string, Promise<S>][] { return [...this.live].map(([key, l]) => [key, l.server]); }

  /** Stop every server: the sidecar is closing. */
  close(): void { for (const key of [...this.live.keys()]) this.stop(key, "closed"); }

  private idleTimer(key: string): ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> {
    const t = setTimeout(() => this.stop(key, "idle"), this.idleMs);
    t.unref?.();
    return t;
  }

  private leastLately(): string | undefined {
    let pick: string | undefined;
    let at = Infinity;
    for (const [key, l] of this.live) if (l.usedAt < at) { at = l.usedAt; pick = key; }
    return pick;
  }

  private stop(key: string, why: "idle" | "cap" | "closed"): void {
    const l = this.live.get(key);
    if (!l) return;
    clearTimeout(l.idle);
    this.live.delete(key);
    l.server.then((s) => s.stop(), () => {});
    this.opts.onStop?.(key, why);
  }
}
